recognize_zh: 多數小型淋巴球內有一個大的圓形透明球狀包涵體（箭頭附近），把核擠向一側，另有數個塗抹細胞；包涵體有大有小，部分細胞含多個小包涵體。
features: Small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Many lymphocytes with one large, round, clear globular inclusion displacing or indenting the nucleus
Some lymphocytes with multiple smaller inclusions
Normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin. Most contain a large, round, clear globular cytoplasmic inclusion that indents or displaces the nucleus, while others contain several smaller inclusions. Smudge cells are frequent, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with lymphocyte cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Mott cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and their immunoglobulin globules are PAS-positive.
Storage diseases show multiple small uniform vacuoles in polyclonal lymphocytes, without a monoclonal lymphocytosis or smudge cells.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei and gray vacuolated cytoplasm, whereas these are small round lymphocytes.
